name: circuitpathways-cloudflare
description: Circuit Pathways on Cloudflare Workers (static assets + D1 + Durable Objects). See README.md.

scripts.dev: sh build.sh && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --local
scripts.deploy: sh build.sh && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:pi: sh build.sh --beta && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env pi && wrangler deploy --env pi
